_note: AI classification (two independent passes, A and B) of each Korean skill against the official 6-grade 한국어 표준 교육과정 (문화체육관광부고시 제2020-54호 별책1) achievement standards. NOT teacher/native review. NOT a TOPIK level. Skill ids are the learning-record keys and are unchanged. gradeRange is stored when the two passes differ. areas lists skills the app questions can actually exercise (recognition by multiple choice is listening/reading recognition, not speaking/writing performance).
